CodeJam:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Reads n words, reverses each word into rw, bubble-sorts the original words, counts common-prefix lengths between consecutive reversed strings, builds two parity-based prefix sums in max, and prints the larger of max[998] and max[999]." CodeJam]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> n </REF>: int "Number of words to read from standard input and process; the word arrays are sized for up to 1000 words."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Declare int i, j, k; declare char arrays tmp, word, rw each with dimensions 1000 by 51; declare int arrays match and max each of size 1000 and zero-initialize them; then set k = 0 (k is otherwise unused). RESULT state_initialized]
            [COMMAND For i starting at 0, while i != n, incrementing i, read a string into word[i] using scanf("%s", word[i]). RESULT word_loaded]
            [COMMAND For i starting at 0, while i != 1000, incrementing i, and for each such i, for j starting at 0, while j != 50, incrementing j, copy word[i][j] into rw[i][j]. RESULT rw_base_copied]
            [COMMAND For i starting at 0, while i != n, incrementing i, and for j starting at 0, while j != strlen(word[i]), incrementing j, set rw[i][j] = word[i][strlen(word[i]) - j - 1], reversing each input word into rw[i]. RESULT rw_reversed]
            [COMMAND For i starting at 0, while i != n - 1, incrementing i, and for j starting at 0, while j != n - 1 - i, incrementing j, if strcmp(word[j], word[j + 1]) > 0, swap word[j] and word[j + 1] using tmp[j] as temporary storage; this bubble-sorts word lexicographically and does not modify rw. RESULT word_sorted]
            [COMMAND For i starting at 0, while i != n - 1, incrementing i, and for j starting at 0 with the loop condition as written and interpreted by C precedence as (j != (strlen(rw[i]) > strlen(rw[i + 1]))) ? strlen(rw[i + 1]) : strlen(rw[i]), incrementing j after each iteration, compare rw[i][j] with rw[i + 1][j]; if they are equal increment match[i], otherwise break out of the inner loop. RESULT match_computed]
            [COMMAND Assign max[0] = match[0] and max[1] = match[1]. RESULT max_seeded]
            [COMMAND For i starting at 2, while i != 1000, incrementing i, set max[i] = max[i - 2] + match[i], so i covers 2 through 999 inclusive. RESULT max_filled]
            [COMMAND Print max[999] > max[998] ? max[999] : max[998] as a decimal integer followed by a newline. RESULT answer_printed]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
